notes: Heuristic: a form with a phone or e-mail field plus a message, or request wording. Field lists, the consent checkbox and its pre-checked state come from the form scan, not from this entry. Callback wording also appears under comms.calls_calltracking.
Detects sign-up flows and account infrastructure (auth libraries, password fields). react-hook-form register() calls are deliberately not matched.

A Django form class or a template form with a CSRF token: data is posted to the server. Which fields it has and whether they are personal data comes from the form scan. Search forms without a token are not matched.
verify: Android and iOS package names (com.vk.id:*, VKID pod); @vkid/sdk confirmed.
Confirmed in the official docs: com.yandex.android:authsdk (Android), YaAuthSuggest.init, YandexAuthLoginOptions. verify: the iOS YandexLoginSDK name and the yastatic.net script path.
Confirmed: esia-connector (PyPI). A plain link to the Gosuslugi portal is not matched.
The Login Widget shares telegram-widget.js with post and comment widgets, so the script host alone is weak; the data-telegram-login attribute is specific. verify: the npm package names.
Facebook Login shows Meta's brand on the login screen. verify: @greatsumini/react-facebook-login.

title_en: SMS one-time code login or verification
notes: Pairs with comms.sms: the SMS gateway behind the code is matched there.

Generic cart, order and checkout signals: something is sold online, goods, services or content. Physical goods are matched under commerce.cart_physical only with a delivery or shipping signal. verify: @saleor/sdk and snipcart hosts.

title_en: Cart and orders for physical goods
notes: Physical goods: a delivery or shipping signal (shipping fields, delivery services, pick-up wording). Cart and checkout tokens alone are matched under commerce.checkout. verify: the cdek, boxberry and pochta API hosts.
Weak evidence: the product categories sold are an owner fact. Needs owner confirmation of the catalog categories.
verify: @lemonsqueezy/lemonsqueezy.js package name. In-app digital goods are matched under mobile.iap.
verify: dikidi.net host.
Weak evidence: prepayment is mostly an owner fact about the business model; signals only suggest it. Needs owner confirmation.

Saved-card tokens (save_payment_method, setup_future_usage) are weak evidence of recurring charges: they also serve one-click payments, so they are not matched; the owner confirms whether charges repeat.
verify: mindbox.ru, uds.app and loymax.tech hosts. Mindbox is also a marketing platform.

title_ru: Розыгрыши, конкурсы и акции с призами
notes: Wording heuristic for contests, giveaways and prize draws. Discounts and promo codes alone are matched under commerce.promo_codes.

Confirmed: yookassa (pip), @webzaytsev/yookassa-ts-sdk, the checkout-widget.js script and YooMoneyCheckoutWidget. verify: @a2seven/yoo-checkout and the mobile SDK names. yoomoney.ru also serves wallet donation forms.

Confirmed: cp.CloudPayments and the widget.cloudpayments.ru/bundles/cloudpayments.js script. Flutter packages cloudpayments_sdk (wraps the native SDKs) and cloudpayments_api (community REST client) exist on pub.dev. verify: the cloudpayments PyPI name (not found in a registry search) and the iOS pod.

verify: all package names and hosts. The brand moved from Tinkoff to T-Bank, so SDK and host names may differ in current docs; TerminalKey and the securepay form are long-standing. verify: securepay.tbank.ru and integrationjs.tbank.ru (new brand hosts).
Confirmed: robokassa and aiorobokassa on PyPI (unofficial clients). verify: an npm package of the same name.

title_en: Payments via the Faster Payments System (SBP)
notes: SBP is usually a payment method of a provider (YooKassa, CloudPayments, T-Bank) or a direct bank QR link; the nspk.ru host appears in QR links and widgets.
Widgets and buttons of third-party installment operators (Dolyame, Podeli, Mokka, Yandex Split). A bank's own consumer loan is not matched. verify: all hosts and the split.yandex.ru widget path.
Confirmed: stripe, @stripe/stripe-js, loadStripe, js.stripe.com. Only publishable keys (pk_) are matched, never secret keys.
Confirmed: @paddle/paddle-js, @paddle/paddle-node-sdk and cdn.paddle.com/paddle/v2/paddle.js. verify: paddle-python-sdk and the checkout hosts.

title_en: Fiscal receipts and online cash registers
notes: verify: atol, orangedata, modulkassa and checkonline hosts. Receipt fields are also YooKassa and CloudPayments request parameters.
verify: @stripe/react-connect-js. Deal.create / fee_moment are YooKassa Safe Deal (split payment) calls.

title_en: Web analytics counters (Metrica, GA and similar)
notes: Counters of Top.Mail.ru and VK are matched under ads.pixels; Google Tag Manager containers under analytics.tag_manager. Mobile analytics SDKs are matched under analytics.mobile_sdk. Webvisor is matched under analytics.session_replay.
Webvisor is a flag of the Yandex Metrica init call, so the counter signals in analytics.web_counter fire too. verify: UXCam package names (flutter_uxcam, react-native-ux-cam, com.uxcam:uxcam).

Domestic ad pixels. The Top.Mail.ru counter (top-fwz1.mail.ru, _tmr) is both a counter and the VK/myTarget pixel. Foreign pixels are matched under ads.pixels_foreign, Facebook Login under auth.facebook. verify: ads.vk.com and vk.ru/rtrg.

title_ru: Иностранные рекламные пиксели (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads и др.)
title_en: Foreign ad pixels and ad SDKs (Meta, TikTok, Google Ads and others)
notes: Pixels and ad SDKs of foreign platforms: Meta, TikTok, X, LinkedIn, Pinterest, Snap, Google Ads conversion tags. react-native-fbsdk-next also carries Facebook Login, matched under auth.facebook.
A container can load any other tracker after consent, so a tag manager is reported separately from the counters it may load.

Confirmed: appmetrica_plugin (pub.dev), @appmetrica/react-native-analytics (npm), io.appmetrica.analytics:analytics (Gradle), firebase_analytics, @react-native-firebase/analytics, FirebaseAnalytics (pod), AppMetricaCore and AppMetricaAnalytics (CocoaPods). verify: appmetrica_push_plugin, the Adjust, AppsFlyer, MyTracker and Mixpanel package names, and tracker-api.my.com.

Embedded chat widgets that collect visitors' messages and contacts (Jivo, Tawk, Crisp, Intercom and others). Plain messenger links are matched under chat.messenger_links, Telegram Login under auth.telegram. verify: tidio, amocrm and bitrix24 hosts.
A t.me, wa.me or viber link is weak evidence: it proves a contact channel in a foreign messenger, not that the site collects messages or personal data. The owner confirms how the channel is used.

Transactional senders (nodemailer, plain SMTP, SendGrid, Mailgun, Resend, Postmark) are deliberately not listed: service e-mails alone are not marketing. verify: esputnik, mailganer, notisend, sendsay, sendpulse and mailerlite hosts.
Local-only notifications (flutter_local_notifications) are not listed. verify: onesignal-node, pushwoosh, rustore and appmetrica push package names.
Matches any SMS gateway, including the one behind auth.sms_otp. verify: exolve, devino (integrationapi.net) and Telegram Gateway hosts.
Call tracking swaps phone numbers per visitor and records calls; callback wording also fires forms.contact. verify: binotel, zadarma, callbackhunter, ringostat and mango-office hosts.
schema.org Review markup may only display third-party ratings; confirm whether visitors can post.
Heuristic: model, component and wording names. The chat-widget vendors are matched under chat.widget.
Heuristic: route and field names. Whether a profile is visible to other visitors is an owner fact.
Photos and video of people may carry personal data; image-consent wording is decided downstream.
Photo, video and avatar uploads: pictures of people may need consent to use the image. Any file input is matched under ugc.uploads.
verify: mts-link.ru, bizon365.ru and telemost.yandex.ru hosts. Course platforms are matched under sector.education_courses.
Weak evidence from keywords and age fields: the real audience is an owner fact. Needs owner confirmation.

Weak evidence from age-gate wording and checks: the real audience is an owner fact. Needs owner confirmation. A bare 18+ mark (for example the age sign of an information product in a footer) is not matched: it does not show an adult audience or an age check.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone. verify: skillspace.ru and ispringlearn.ru hosts.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone. Health-data SDKs (HealthKit, Health Connect) are stronger evidence than text. verify: react-native-health-connect and hl7apy package names.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone.

Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone. Typical owner facts: the operator is a state or municipal body, or runs a state information system.

title_en: Sector: taxi, passenger transport and tourism
notes: Weak evidence from keywords on page text and identifiers: the field of business is an owner fact (company activity codes, licences). Needs owner confirmation; do not apply sector-only requirements from this signal alone. verify: amadeus (npm and pip) and the travel widget hosts.

Confirmed: openai, @anthropic-ai/sdk, anthropic, gigachat (default hosts gigachat.devices.sberbank.ru, ngw.devices.sberbank.ru, api.giga.chat), yandex-ai-studio-sdk (YandexGPT). verify: yandex-cloud-ml-sdk (older name), llm.api.cloud.yandex.net, dart_openai and the Gradle coordinates. Local-only inference (ollama, transformers) is not listed because no data leaves the device. Page wording counts only as product UI (an assistant, ask-the-AI, explicit vendor attribution); articles and marketing about neural networks are not matched. Foreign providers are also matched under tech.generative_ai_foreign.

SDKs, client classes, model names and API hosts of foreign providers (OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Mistral, Cohere, Groq, DeepSeek and others). GigaChat and YandexGPT are domestic and are matched only under tech.generative_ai. The OpenAI SDK can be pointed at another base URL, so the API host is the strongest evidence.

Libraries, services and wording of personalised recommendations. A static block of the same products for everyone is not personalisation; the owner confirms whether the feed uses user preferences. verify: recombee-api-client and the Retail Rocket hosts.
In a repository these signals show the product ships as an app. Store badges and links on a website only show that an app exists; the store listing itself is checked separately.
verify: ru.rustore.sdk:billingclient, adapty and RevenueCat package names.

title_en: App tracking permission and advertising identifiers (ATT)

notes: RuStore SDKs in the app or a link to its RuStore page. verify: the flutter_rustore_* package names.

Self-hosted font setups (next/font/google, @fontsource/*, @expo-google-fonts/*) are intentionally not matched: they do not call Google at runtime. The Flutter google_fonts package fetches fonts at runtime unless they are bundled as assets (verify per project).
Yandex SmartCaptcha is a different entry (captcha.smartcaptcha). Local captchas (django-simple-captcha) are not matched. verify: recaptcha_enterprise_flutter and react-turnstile package names.

Domestic counterpart of foreign.captcha, listed so a scan can tell reCAPTCHA from SmartCaptcha. Confirmed: window.smartCaptcha.render and the smartcaptcha.cloud.yandex.ru/captcha.js script. verify: captcha-api.yandex.ru (legacy).

title_ru: Библиотеки и стили с иностранных CDN
title_en: Libraries and styles from foreign CDNs
notes: Scripts, styles and icon fonts loaded from public library CDNs: the visitor's browser sends a request to a foreign server, as with web fonts. No user data is stored there by the product.

title_ru: Иностранные CDN, хостинг и облачные сервисы
title_en: Foreign CDNs, hosting and cloud services
notes: Foreign backend, serverless, backend-as-a-service and object-storage platforms (Firebase, Supabase, Vercel, Netlify, AWS, Azure, Google Cloud). Where the server and database physically sit is an owner fact and cannot be read from code. Library CDNs are matched under foreign.static_cdn.

Each embed is a third-party request from the visitor's browser; embedded form builders (Google Forms, Typeform, Jotform, Tally, Airtable) also collect data in a foreign service. Yandex Maps, Rutube and VK Video embeds are not matched.

title_en: Foreign services that receive user data
notes: Foreign SDKs and services to which the product or the visitor's browser sends personal data: analytics, attribution, crash reporting, session replay, chat, mailing and push providers. Domestic services (Yandex Metrica, AppMetrica, Jivo, Unisender) are not listed. Sentry and Segment are matched by their cloud hosts only, because both can be self-hosted; self-hosted PostHog is matched only by its library, so the owner confirms where the data goes. verify: firebaselogging-pa.googleapis.com.

title_en: Advertising on the own site or app (erid, ad blocks)
notes: Covers both labelled advertising placed by the owner (erid tokens, ad labels) and third-party ad blocks shown on the site. verify: ad.mail.ru, ads.adfox.ru and adriver.ru hosts.

title_ru: Символика и ссылки Instagram и Facebook
title_en: Instagram and Facebook symbols and links
notes: Matches links, logos, icons and plain mentions of Instagram and Facebook. Meta Platforms SDKs and pixels are matched under ads.pixels.

Weak evidence: a mention of VPN in text or a VPN-capable app. Whether the product offers or advertises circumvention is an owner fact. Needs owner confirmation. Generic dev-server proxy settings are deliberately not matched. A plain mention of VPN (for example a corporate VPN for staff) is not matched; only offer and ad wording is.

Weak evidence: locale lists, a non-Russian default language, hreflang alternates or a language switcher. Whether a Russian version exists and is complete is checked in the interface and confirmed with the owner. i18n libraries are not listed because they also serve Russian-only products.

Confirmed: aiogram, python-telegram-bot (telegram.ext), pyTelegramBotAPI (import telebot), telegraf, grammy, node-telegram-bot-api; Bot API host api.telegram.org (core.telegram.org/bots/api). A t.me link alone is chat.messenger_links, not a bot.

Confirmed: @maxhub/max-bot-api (official TypeScript client), maxapi (unofficial Python client reviewed by MAX), max_client (generated Python client); API host platform-api2.max.ru, earlier platform-api.max.ru (dev.max.ru/docs-api).

title_ru: Мини-приложение в мессенджере (Telegram Mini App, MAX)
title_en: Mini app inside a messenger (Telegram Mini App, MAX)
notes: Confirmed: telegram-web-app.js and window.Telegram.WebApp (core.telegram.org/bots/webapps), @twa-dev/sdk, @telegram-apps/sdk; MAX Bridge exposes window.WebApp.initData (dev.max.ru). telegram-widget.js is the login widget (auth.telegram), not a mini app.

title_ru: Оплата счётом в чате бота (провайдер платежей)
title_en: In-chat invoice payments in a bot (payment provider)
notes: Confirmed: sendInvoice / createInvoiceLink with provider_token and pre_checkout_query (core.telegram.org/bots/payments). The same calls with currency XTR are Telegram Stars (payments.telegram_stars).
Confirmed: currency XTR and refundStarPayment (core.telegram.org/bots/payments-stars). Platform rule: digital goods in bots are sold only for Stars.
